answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A plume of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The horizon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
